name: Trustwell Hospitals
description: Bengaluru-based hospital planning a 100-bed expansion.

name: Dr. Aditi's Dental Clinic
description: Welcome to Dr. Aditi's Dental Clinic, where precision meets compassion and smiles are crafted with care. Founded by Dr. Aditi Desai, a distinguished practitioner in the fields of Periodontics and Oral Implantology, our clinic stands as a beacon of excellence in dental care. Dr. Aditi Desai, with her extensive experience since 2019, brings a wealth of expertise to the table. Having successfully conducted over 100 implants and numerous intricate surgeries, she is renowned for her skillful hands and unwavering dedication to patient well-being.

name: Asian Health Meter
description: Asian Health Meter was established in the year 2009. We are Service Provider of 4D Ultra Sound Scan, Colonoscopy, Diagnostic Histopathology, Digital X Ray, Endoscopy, Hematology Test, Magnetic Resource Imaging (MRI), Mammography, Medical Diagnosis, Multi Slice CT Scan etc. Asian Health Alliance Pvt. Ltd., is developing a network and alliance of diagnostic centers across the country under the brand name of Asian Health Meter. It aims to bring high quality and competitive healthcare delivery to the millions of population across BOP (Bottom of Pyramid) in rural India. Promoted by the key promoters of the Asian Heart Institute, Mumbai, we bring our skills, knowledge, and industry best practices to the enterprise.

name: Dr Karam Singh Memorial Multispeciality Hospital
description: Dr Karam Singh Memorial Multispeciality Hospital is a 100+ bedded hospital situated in centre of city of Amritsar. This hospital was started in 1960’s by legendary Orthopedic surgeon Dr Karam Singh. Jannat Enterprise a partnership firm took over the hospital in 2010 and since then it is being run by it. In 2014 this hospital was renovated and bed capacity was increased from 20 beds to 100+ beds. It is centrally airconditioned building and is equipped with ultramodern medical facilities. It was accredited with NABH in Jan 2018 and is recognized for all general and superspeciality services. The hospital has a dedicated team of doctors and many superspecialists of the city are on its panel. The hospital has kept cleanliness as its main aim. Utmost care is being taken to keep the hospital clean and free from any kind of infection.

name: Yashomati Hospital
description: The Hospital is a 240 bedded hospital with 7 operation theatres within its premises. Yashomati Hospitals Private Limited is a Private Hospital incorporated on 16 March 2007. It is based at Yashomati Hospitals Pvt Ltd since December 2018.

name: Chandrakona Rural Hospital, Chandrakona II CD block, Chandrakona, 60 beds
description: Khirpai Rural Hospital, with 30 beds at Khirpai, is the major government medical facility in the Chandrakona I CD block.

name: Akash Healthcare and Diagnostics
description: Akash Healthcare and Diagnostics was formerly Sanram Pathology Lab started by Dr.Shalini Sharma in the year 2010 with the aim of providing quality and affordable healthcare to the society. Since 2015, Dr Shalini Sharma has been approved by DIRECTORATE GENERAL (DG) OF SHIPPING – GOVERNMENT OF INDIA to conduct SEAFARERS Medical Examination (PEME).

name: Kakaba Hospital
description: Kaka-Ba Hospital is a multi-specialty charitable hospital in Hansot, Bharuch district, Gujarat, India. It provides free healthcare to the marginalised and operates under Kala Budh Public Charitable Trust. It houses over 40 doctors and has treated over 600,000 patients at minimal rates, with more than 25,000 free dialysis cases and a plastic surgery program since 2008 that has treated over 10,000 patients.

name: Tata Memorial Hospital
description: Tata Memorial Hospital is a cancer hospital located in Mumbai, India. It has a sister institution relationship with MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, Texas, USA; established in 2003; facilitated by the Indo-American Chamber of Commerce of Greater Houston. The collaboration focuses on physician education and training, clinical services, research collaboration, quality assurance programs, faculty exchange visits, and nursing and technical staff training.

name: Global MultiSpeciality Hospital & Trauma Center, Azamgarh
description: Global Multispeciality Hospital & Truma Center is a multi speciality hospital & trauma center serving people since 2011. The motto has always been to achieve ‘excellence in patient care’. Through the years it has established itself as a reliable name in healthcare and provides quality and ethical treatment which at the same time is made affordable and customised for each individual patient.

name: Ganga Hospital, Coimbatore
description: Ganga Hospital, Coimbatore hosts the Department of Orthopaedic, Trauma & Spine Surgery, which has been chaired by Dr. S. Rajasekaran since 1991. The department developed to gain international reputation for practicing the ‘High Quality – High Volume – Affordable Cost’ model of health care and has contributed to accessible, affordable tertiary level healthcare.

name: Gurupatham Spine Care Centre
description: Gurupatham Spine Care Centre (GSCC) is a fully established and advanced spinal care centre that focuses on providing non-invasive and non-surgical solutions for spinal problems like disc prolapse, back pain, neck pain etc. Our founder, Dr B Robin Guru Singh, is a spine specialist and an expert in spine manual therapy treatments, working in this area since 2002. We have taken spine care treatment to a new innovative level, ensuring a permanent spinal solution for our patients. GSCC is the result of his successful treatments and methods. Innovative therapies and scientific methods have always been at the core of his process of treating his patients. The outcome is a set of treatment protocols that assure relief in a way that no other spinal treatment can. By incorporating cutting-edge technology into our expertise in spine care, our healing capabilities have grown immensely. Our core competence is in providing wellness solutions that are long-term and non-invasive. And our success rates are at an incredible 90 -95%. Contact us for further details.

name: Lotus Microbiologycs
description: Lotus Microbiologycs is a specialized infectious diseases diagnostic laboratory that integrates conventional microbiology with serological and neo-molecular testing for various pathogens. The lab aims to provide economical, evidence-based diagnoses for a wide range of infectious diseases. Initially operating in the Thane Navi Mumbai area, it aspires to be the leading choice for infectious disease diagnostics in India. With over 50,000 samples tested and more than 100 infectious disease tests offered, the laboratory has been NABH certified since 2018.

name: Ayodhya Eye Hospital
description: Ayodhya Eye Hospital is an eye hospital located in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India. It started as a 10-bed eye clinic and now performs about 13,000 surgeries per year, serving a catchment area of 3,600 sq. km.

name: Praanadha Ayurveda Hospital
description: Praanadha Ayurveda Hospital is owned and operated by Doctor MK ARUN and Doctor NEETHU KP. The doctors started practicing Ayurveda since 2007. The hospital opened in 2014. It offers traditional Ayurveda treatments including Panchakarma for detox and rejuvenation, and various therapies for conditions like arthritis, spondylosis, skin diseases, lifestyle disorders, female care, and postnatal care.

name: Hindu Rao Hospital
description: Hindu Rao Hospital, a top government hospital in Delhi, began as a 16-bed nursing home in 1911, serving North Delhi and beyond. Managed by the North Delhi Municipal Corporation, this government hospital in Delhi became a referral centre in 1963 and started a medical college in 2013, training 50 MBBS students yearly.

name: SCB Medical College and Hospital, Cuttack
description: SCB Medical College’s cancer wing was established in 1971; a cobalt-60 teletherapy unit was started in 1972 and was the 8th cobalt-60 installation in India; the cancer wing expanded with surgical and chemotherapy services and was upgraded to Regional Cancer Research and Treatment Center (RCCTC) in 1981; the regional cancer center at SCB Medical College, Cuttack is mentioned as one of the ten regional cancer centers in the National Cancer Control Programme booklet (July 1984).

name: Gandhi Hospital
description: Gandhi Hospital has a glorious history of about 170 years. Started as an infirmary of 3 wards in 1851, developed into a Cantonment Hospital with 95 beds in 1900, and evolved into Gandhi Medical College. Gandhi Medical College was established in 1954 and recognized by MCI in 1956, becoming a teaching hospital in 1958 for Gandhi Medical College. Presently, Gandhi Hospital has an operational bed strength of 2200 and is a premier institution of post-doctoral medical education and training serving Telangana and neighboring states. It was the first open heart surgery centre of the combined state of Andhra Pradesh and the first to have Cathlab facilities for training of DM cardiology students.

name: Emc Super Speciality Hospital
description: Specialties: - The medicine departments of this hospital along with their sub specialities are rendering commendable services. Treatment of many neurological disorders is available. Endocrinology, Gastroeneterology, departments are also rendering latest treatment facilities.  - It comprises of facilities such as Pediatrics, ENT, Psychiatry, Biochemistry and pathology and others.   Amenities:   - The hospital has 24X7 in house Blood bank service is also a very important support.   - It has 6 bedded surgical intensive care unit with all modern life support system (24x7) is an asset to our hospital.  - The hospital also has 6 bedded CCU with all modern lifesaving support is also pride to this institution   - ICCU 6 beds and Semi ICCU 6 beds take care of cardiological emergencies under able cardiologists of this hospital.

name: Nahar Medical Centre
description: Welcome to Nahar Medical Centre, a premier state-of-the-art medical and diagnostic facility located in Chandivali, Mumbai. At Nahar Medical Centre, your well-being is our top priority. From the moment you step in, you are greeted with warmth, hospitality, and a commitment to helping you return to optimal health.Our center offers a serene and calming atmosphere, designed to put you at ease. We provide comprehensive care with the support of a professional and confident team, ensuring a comfortable experience for all our patients. Our facility includes modern amenities such as Wi-Fi-enabled lounges and an in-house coffee shop, delivering a blend of healthcare and comfort.Part of the esteemed Nahar Group, a leading name in real estate since 1973, Nahar Medical Centre extends the Group’s commitment to quality and excellence into the healthcare sector. The Nahar Group, known for its top-tier residential and industrial developments, now brings the same dedication to improving the quality of life through superior healthcare services.Our team is focused on addressing your concerns with expert medical consultancy and empathetic interactions. Experience top-notch healthcare in a facility designed to make every patient feel comfortable and cared for. Our facility has state-of-the-art equipment's and forms the basis for all our diagnostic and medical reports , prayer room.The calm, serene atmosphere; the confident and professional staff, WIFI enabled lounges, the coffee shop, are all part of the 'Nahar Medical Center design'.

name: Satish Nursing Home
description: Satish Nursing Home is a private hospital in Mainpuri, Uttar Pradesh. A 5-storey facility with 50 beds, inaugurated in 2020, offers 24/7 emergency services, ICU, operation theater, delivery room, NICU, burn ward, general and private wards, oxygen plant, and an upcoming dialysis wing. NABH accreditation received on March 31, 2022.

name: Agartala Government Medical College
description: Agartala Government Medical College and G. B. Pant Hospital is one of the six state hospitals in Tripura; located in Agartala, it is a public hospital under the Directorate of Health Services. Notable recent developments include two new super-specialist doctors appointed (Dr. Udayan Saha, Nephrology and Dr. Rimjhim Chakma, Cardiac Anaesthesia), establishment of a 200-bed Maternal & Child Health (MCH) II wing with OPD and IVF centre, and a rise in inpatient bed capacity from 727 to 1413.

name: Janta Hospital
description: Welcome to Janta Hospital, where we are committed to providing you and your family with exceptional care and service. We are proud to care for you with compassion, dignity and respect. The modern state of the art 100 bedded hospital has the most eminent panel of medical professionals, a well-trained paramedical staff and the most skilled & caring nursing professionals.

name: Co-operative Hospital
description: Thalassery Co-Operative Hospital is a cooperative medical institution in Thalassery, Kerala, India, offering 250 beds, 6 ICUs, and over 20 specialty departments, with 24x7 emergency services and a wide range of specialties.

name: Krishna Rajendra Hospital - KR Hospital, Irwin Rd, Devaraja Mohalla, Yadavagiri, Mysuru, Karnataka 570001
description: Krishna Rajendra Hospital is a government-owned, multi-specialty hospital in Mysore, India. It operates a blood bank started in 1998, staffed by 14 personnel, and funded by the government. The hospital has about 1,330 beds and provides 24-hour emergency care, radiology, microbiology, pathology, biochemistry labs, blood bank, and pharmacy. It has a cardiology department established in collaboration with Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences & Research; the hospital is also associated with Mysore Medical College for clinical training.

name: Sree Renga Hospital
description: SRH, Chengalpattu, is a hospital with NABH accreditation since 2012 and NABL accreditation for its laboratory. It provides diagnostic services including Laboratory, X Ray, Ultrasound, Echocardiography, Colour Doppler, TreadMill Test, Pulmonary Function Test, Endoscopy, Colonoscopy, and Uroflowmetry. Its facilities include Emergency Room, Intensive Care Unit, High Dependency Unit, Central Sterile Supply Department, Blood Storage, Day Care Services, 24 hours Pharmacy, Ambulance, Laundry, and Fitness Clinic. It hosts the Centre for Quality Promotion (CQP) and has participated in World Patient Safety Day events.

name: Bapu Nature Cure Hospital & Yogashram
description: Est in 1985 - A 50 Bedded Hospital - One of the leading Institutes in India for Naturopathy, Yoga, Ayurveda and Physiotherapy. With a team of 20+ Doctors and well established Research & Development Department with specialisation in Diabetes, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Osteo Arthritis, Thyroid and other lifestyle diseases. Also, having full fledged academy - Livelihood Business Incubation centre running courses for Naturopathy Therapist, Yoga Therapist, Ayurveda Therapist, etc.

name: John Bishop Memorial Hospital
description: John Bishop Memorial Hospital (JBMH) is a 20-bed hospital in Anantnag, south Kashmir. It is one of Kashmir's oldest health facilities, established in the late 19th century by Isabella Bird in Srinagar and named in memory of Dr John Bishop. The hospital is affiliated with the Church of North India and the Diocese of Amritsar. It also runs a nursing school since 1965 offering GNM and FMPHW courses, producing about 40 female professionals annually. The hospital was revived in the 1990s after being on a ventilator and remains a key medical facility serving the local population; it handles thousands of patients with hundreds of births annually (350-400 per year).

name: Lifeline Infertility, Endoscopic, and IVF Centre
description: Lifeline IVF Center, Mumbai’s trusted fertility clinic since 1998, delivers personalized IVF, ICSI, blastocyst and donor treatments.

name: Southern Railway Head Quarters Hospital
description: Southern Railway Headquarters Hospital is situated in Perambur, Chennai, and is the tertiary referral hospital of the Southern Railway. It provides comprehensive multidisciplinary state-of-the-art treatment to all the beneficiaries of the Indian Railways, especially to the beneficiaries of the Southern Railway. The hospital has 505 beds catering to patients of various specialties and super-specialty departments. It is an established teaching hospital under the NBEMS having DNB trainees in 9 specialties and 2 super specialty departments.
